company.name: Lanternfish Labs
company.tagline: A small software consultancy that builds and maintains apps for growing companies.
company.summary: A twelve-person remote consultancy. Pairing when someone is stuck, weekly planning on Mondays.
company.about: Lanternfish Labs is a twelve-person consultancy. Most of the team works remotely, with a weekly planning call on Mondays and pairing sessions whenever someone is stuck. New developers start on a client project right away, fixing small, real bugs from their first week.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Lanternfish Labs!
welcome.body:
Hi, great to have you with us!

I'm Rafaela, the engineering manager. Your project is on its way: once it is downloaded (Dashboard → Download and install), you'll find the client, the project and your first ticket here.

Rafaela
